card.name: Digits inside p-values
card.fires_on: The digits and decimal point right after p< or P< in reported statistics, such as the 0 in p<0.05 or p<0.005. Weaker on a few other words in trial-result sentences.

modes.label: P-value digits
modes.description: A zero, point or digit partway through a p-value after p< or P<.

modes.label: Trial-result wording
modes.description: Occasional words in sentences about study design or statistical findings.
modes.example: were designed to<< rule>> out a risk margin of 2.
